title: 1833. Maximum Ice Cream Bars

examples.explanation: The boy can buy ice cream bars at indices 0,1,2,4 for a total price of 1 + 3 + 2 + 1 = 7.
The boy cannot afford any of the ice cream bars.
The boy can buy all the ice cream bars for a total price of 1 + 6 + 3 + 1 + 2 + 5 = 18.
